request.style: English, chill electronic worship, deep house groove, soft kick, glassy synth plucks, a warm male vocal with vocal chops, flowing and serene, 118 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Then the angel showed me the river
The river of the water of life
Bright as crystal, flowing from the throne
Of God and of the Lamb

[Chorus]
River of life, flow through the city
Tree of life on either side
Leaves for the healing of the nations
River of life

[Verse]
No longer will there be anything accursed
They will see his face
His name will be on their foreheads
And night will be no more

[Chorus]
River of life, flow through the city
Tree of life on either side
Leaves for the healing of the nations
River of life

[Outro]
The Lord God will be their light
